records.name: Women Healed for a Purpose
records.summary: Helps women learn more about themselves and grow in confidence. Each year it hosts a daylong conference, and women can register to attend or sign up to volunteer.
records.what_you_do: Register for the yearly L.I.F.E. conference, sign up to help run it, or support the group with a donation.

schedule.text: Annual L.I.F.E. conference. The 5th one is Saturday, October 17, 2026, 11 am to 3 pm; the page lists no other dates

locations.label: Conference venue (Brand New Life Christian Center)

first_step.how: Use the Register link on womenhealed4apurpose.org to sign up for the October 17, 2026 conference
first_step.basis: Public conference with a clear register link; the page does not say how newcomers are welcomed

records.notes: The conference is dated 2026 and is upcoming, so status is active. The venue on the site is the same street address as the IRS record. Donation links (PayPal, Cash App) are not recorded. No faith affiliation is stated on the site, so none is recorded.

records.name: Women of Faith and Hope
records.notes: wofah.org loaded with no page text on two fetches (with and without www), and no search budget was left, so nothing could be verified. Held back: no summary, categories or interests. IRS address 6001 Germantown Ave, 19144, not published on a page we could read. Recheck the site or find another public source before publishing.

records.name: Youth With a Mission Greater Philadelphia
records.summary: A Christian mission group that offers free prayer in public places each week and does street outreach in the city. It also hosts short mission teams and helps churches take part.
records.what_you_do: Pray with people at the weekly prayer stations, join an outreach team, or bring a church team to serve in the city.

schedule.text: Free prayer stations in public places every week; the page does not list days or hours

cost.text: Prayer at the stations is free; no fees for ministry programs are listed

first_step.how: Email connect@ywamphiladelphia.org to ask how to join a weekly prayer station or an outreach team
first_step.basis: Prayer stations are open to anyone in public spaces, and the site gives a contact address for joining teams

records.notes: The IRS listing types this as a congregation. The site calls itself a mission organization and does not say it is a church, so kind is nonprofit. No denomination is stated, so faith is left out. The site has no dated news or events, so status is probably active from a working site with no dates. Joshua Generation, linked from this site, is in leads_only.

records.name: AHARI (A Home Is A Right)
records.summary: Helps veterans and their families with housing and support services. It runs a yearly Veteran Stand Down, and volunteers are needed to help at it.
records.what_you_do: Sign up to volunteer at the Veteran Stand Down, point veterans to the Get Help page, or support the group with a donation.

schedule.text: Annual Veteran Stand Down, 2026. The site lists it as upcoming but gives no date

first_step.how: Use the Volunteer link on aharihomes.org, or email ahari.at.work@gmail.com, to sign up to help at the 2026 Veteran Stand Down
first_step.basis: Volunteer sign-up is public and linked from the site; event details are not listed yet

records.notes: Status is active because the upcoming Stand Down is labeled 2026, but the page gives no month, so last_sign_of_life is left out. The address on the site differs from the IRS listing (215 S Melville St, 19139); the published address is used.

records.name: Broken Wings Literacy Center
records.summary: Offers literacy and mental health support to children who have learning or behavior challenges. The center says its services run year round and invites families to call or email.
records.what_you_do: Families call or email to ask about literacy and mental health services for a child.

schedule.text: Services described as year round; days and hours are not listed

first_step.how: Call 833-899-4280 or email brokenwingsliteracycenter@yahoo.com to ask how a child can start literacy or mental health services
first_step.basis: The site says services run year round but lists no enrollment steps; phone and email are the only way in

records.notes: The newest dated item on the site is a 2016 book release, and the other dates are 2011 or earlier, so status is dormant even though the site still gives phone and email and says services are year round. Verify with the center before showing it as active.

records.name: C.A.R.E. Foundation
records.notes: Legal name: Continuous Acts to Restore Encouragement. The site says the group was founded in Washington, D.C. in 2017, and its listed work is mostly abroad (Ghana, Sierra Leone, Kenya, Haiti, Egypt). Its only dated Philadelphia items are from 2018 and 2019 (a Thanksgiving giveback, a toy drive at a North Philadelphia shelter, and a 2019 brunch), plus a Love Park giveback with no date. The homepage lists a 2026 Ghana trip with no month. No current Philadelphia program is listed, so it is out of area. IRS address 5310 Market Street. No summary, status or categories recorded.

records.name: Cross Community Service Center
records.summary: A nonprofit that runs science, technology, engineering, and math (STEM) learning, trains teachers, provides educators to K to 12 schools, and helps adults build work skills.
records.what_you_do: Adult learners can take part in workforce skills programs, and schools can use the group for teacher training and educator staffing.

first_step.how: Call 267-466-6439 or email cross.ccsc@gmail.com to ask how an adult or a school can join a program
first_step.basis: The site has a Join link but does not say how to sign up for programs or volunteer roles

records.notes: No dated events or news on the site; the year in the footer is a copyright line and is not counted. Status is probably active only because the site works. The IRS record lists 4501 Walnut St, 19139; the published address is used.

records.name: Do Moore Good
records.notes: The batch website field held the name, not a web address, so it was treated as missing. The one search for this name and Sansom Street found no page for this group. A Moore family foundation with a similar name appeared in the results (mooregood.org, based in Brooklyn), but it is a different organization and was not used. IRS address 4642 Sansom St, 19139, not published anywhere we could read. Held back: no summary, categories or interests.

records.name: ECO Foundation
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit with creative learning, cultural activities, and healthy food programs for young people and their neighbors. It runs a youth cohort and community dinners, and it takes volunteers through an online form.
records.what_you_do: Apply to the youth cohort, sign up to volunteer through the online form, or come to a community dinner.

schedule.text: Young B.U.L. fall 2026 cohort, listed with a start of Wednesday, September 9, 2026. A community dinner is posted for Wednesday 9/9 with no year

first_step.how: Fill in the Volunteer With ECO form linked on theecofoundation.com, or email contact@theecofoundation.com to ask about the next youth cohort
first_step.basis: Volunteer sign-up is open to anyone through a public form; the youth cohort needs an application

records.notes: Legal name: Education Culture Opportunities Foundation. The page lists the cohort start as September 9, 2026 and says applications for that cohort are open, but that date had already passed on 2026-10-08, so the page may be out of date. A welcome post dated 2025-12-23 is also on the site. A second contact address (info@theecofoundation.org) is on the site and is not recorded. The cohort application link sits in an Instagram bio and is not recorded.

records.name: IAMM Science Education Group
records.summary: Uses science education and open discussion to help Black and Brown students and their communities get into STEAM fields (science, technology, engineering, arts, and math). It runs community screenings and talks and has a scholarship fund.
records.what_you_do: Buy a ticket to a community screening, sign up to volunteer or mentor through the contact form, or apply for the scholarship fund.

schedule.text: Philly Salon 9 screenings were on Saturday, August 22, 2026, at 1 pm and 5 pm. No other dates are listed

cost.text: Ticket price not shown; donations suggested from $25

first_step.how: Email iammscience@gmail.com or use the Sign Up contact form on iammscience.com to ask about volunteering, mentoring, or the next screening
first_step.basis: Volunteer and mentor sign-ups are listed publicly, and screenings are open to anyone who buys a ticket

records.notes: The organization's own street address is not published; the venue address is for the screening series only. Staff phone numbers and the scholarship email (ipscholarshipfund@gmail.com) are on the site and are not recorded. A 2015 newspaper citation on the page is not counted as evidence.

records.name: Imani Star Development
records.notes: The batch website field held the name, not a web address, so it was treated as missing. The one search for the name found no page for this organization. Results were other Imani groups (Imani Community Development Corporation, Imani Village in Wilmington, Delaware, and a Philadelphia housing listing), none tied to this EIN, so none are used. IRS address 148 S 60th Street, 19139, not published anywhere we could read. Held back: no summary, categories or interests.

records.name: Indigenous Education
records.summary: Shares East Coast Indigenous history and ancestral knowledge through media, online courses, and community events. People can take self-paced courses and support the work through donations.
records.what_you_do: Take a self-paced course through the linked learning site, follow the group's events, or donate.

schedule.text: Self-paced online courses with no set times; a 2026 gala is listed as a PDF with no date

first_step.how: Open the self-paced course link from indedu.org and enroll; use the Contact page on the site to ask about events and volunteering
first_step.basis: Courses are open to anyone through a linked school site, but enrollment terms are not on the page

records.notes: The newest dated item is a March 27, 2026 profile on another outlet's site that features a co-founder, plus a November 14, 2023 PHILADELPHIA250 item. The GALA 2026 PDF has no date on the page. The IRS address (5836 Ludlow St, 19139) is not shown on the website, so no location is recorded. Email is not stated; only a Contact page link is given.

records.name: Ins-Bridging the Gap
records.notes: The site loaded with no page text on two fetches (bare domain and www). No search budget was left for this group, so nothing could be verified. Held back: no summary, categories or interests. IRS address 41 S 54th St, 19139. Recheck the site before publishing.

records.name: Institute for Digital Heritage
records.notes: The site describes open access digital information about culture, artifacts, traditions and materiality, and links an IDH Blog with no dated posts on the page. No volunteer, membership, class or visitor route is listed, so there is no public way in and it is hidden as private. Revisit if the blog or another source shows public programs. IRS address 6033 Walnut St, 19139, not published on the site.

records.name: International League of Muslim Women, Philadelphia Chapter
records.summary: The Philadelphia chapter of a Muslim women's group. It runs service, charity, and education programs and holds yearly events such as a family luncheon and a convention.
records.what_you_do: Use the Join our community link to reach the contact page, come to a yearly event, or donate.

schedule.text: Annual Grandmother, Mother, Daughter Luncheon (listed as 2025) and a 31st Annual Convention. The page gives no dates

first_step.how: Use the Join our community link on tilmwpa.org to reach the contact page and ask about the next luncheon or convention
first_step.basis: The site has a clear join link to a contact page, but event dates and volunteer steps are not listed

records.notes: The newest dated item is the 2025 luncheon, which has a year but no month, so status is probably active rather than active. The site has only a subscribe form, no email or phone. The IRS address (6025 Spruce St, 19139) is not published on the site and is not recorded.

leads_only.name: Joshua Generation
leads_only.note: Named on the Youth With a Mission Greater Philadelphia site as an arts-based evangelism group linked to an external site. The target URL was not recorded and the group was not checked.

notes: All 15 batch groups have a record: 13 publish, 1 hide, 1 out_of_area. Two WebSearch calls were used, both on the two groups with no web address (Do Moore Good and Imani Star Development); neither search found a page for its group, so both are held back with status unknown and no summary. Women of Faith and Hope and Ins-Bridging the Gap returned empty pages on repeated fetches; both are held back with no summary. Continuous Acts events page was checked: its Philadelphia items are from 2018 and 2019 only. No 403, bot checks or paywalls were seen. Records use the everyday name; legal names are in notes. Fetch budget was not exhausted (16 of 60).
